summary: Iter 63 backend testing — Chats archive & soft-delete endpoints. All 19 review-request scenarios pass (27 pytest cases after parametrisation on unarchive/hide/unhide guards). No regressions. Verified archive/unarchive/hide/unhide guard behaviour (401/403/404), full archive lifecycle with per-user semantics, soft-delete outranks archive, auto-resurrect on new peer message (simulated via direct Mongo write matching the WS handler), archived-count endpoint, and that unread-total now excludes hidden threads while still counting archived unread. is_archived bool field is present on every conversation returned by /conversations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 7973: /conversations limits results to 200 via .to_list(200); if a user ever exceeds this the archive/hide filters would silently drop threads. Not blocking for this iteration but worth a note.

The /dm/*/archive|unarchive|hide|unhide endpoints do not verify the conv doc contains the caller in archived_for/hidden_for after the mutation — they always return {ok:true} even on no-op (e.g. calling unhide on a conv the user hasn't hidden). This is idempotent-by-design and matches the WhatsApp semantics; documenting only.
server.py 7978-7981: filter values other than active|archived|all silently fall through to the 'all-but-hidden' branch. Consider explicit validation / 422 for typos (e.g. filter=hidden).
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_i63_* user accounts and one dm_conversations doc created via /api/auth/signup + /api/dm/start. Cleanup autouse fixture deletes any user whose username matches ^TEST_i63_ after the module runs. Orphaned dm_conversations/messages docs are left (uuid IDs, non-colliding, not user-facing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 63 archive/hide endpoints fully green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter63_dm_archive_hide.py is reusable as regression. Uses direct Mongo insert (pymongo) to simulate WS-driven auto-unarchive/auto-unhide by setting archived_for=[] and hidden_for=[] on the conv doc, matching the WS handler around server.py:8492. If the WS handler contract changes (e.g. only resets one of the two arrays), tests test_10 and test_14 will need to be updated to match.
